examples.note: Praia — the first three digits of a fixed number encode the geographic area (26 = Santiago)
Mobile — the 9 prefix carries no geographic meaning

notes: Closed 7-digit plan restructured on 2004-07-03 by prepending digits to the older shorter numbers.
Fixed numbers encode geography in their first three digits; mobile numbers do not.
sources: ARME — Agência Reguladora Multissetorial da Economia: https://www.arme.cv/
